name: Founding Titan
ability: Absolute command over all Subjects of Ymir. Can alter memories, control Pure Titans, harden flesh and, through the Paths, reach across time.
weakness: Requires royal blood to unlock its full power — unless the holder reaches Ymir directly inside the Paths.
history: The first titan, born from Ymir Fritz's pact. Karl Fritz used it to raise the walls and erase a century of memory; Eren Yeager used it to end the world's delay.

name: Attack Titan
ability: Inherits the memories and intentions of future holders — a titan that has always been pushed forward by the people who will come after it.
weakness: No elemental hardening, no armour. It wins through violence, endurance and foreknowledge.
history: Passed hand to hand for two thousand years by Eldians who refused to accept the walls. It has only ever had one purpose: to keep moving forward.

name: Colossal Titan
ability: Emits scalding steam, generates explosive transformation force on a nuclear scale and can harden its body selectively.
weakness: Enormous target, poor mobility, and the transformation consumes the holder's flesh.
history: The wall-breaker. On the day it appeared over Shiganshina, a century of peace ended. Later it becomes the shield over the port of Liberio.

name: Armored Titan
ability: Plates of hardened, bone-like armour across the body. Capable of smashing through gates and walls with a charge.
weakness: Armour plates can be shattered by concentrated thunder spears, exposing the muscle beneath.
history: The titan that broke Wall Maria's inner gate. Reiner carried it for thirteen years and never managed to stop being the person who did that.

name: Female Titan
ability: Versatile hardening, a scream that summons Pure Titans and the best hand-to-hand combat of any titan.
weakness: Relies on the holder's own conditioning; Annie's refusal to fight limits it more than any enemy.
history: Sent to infiltrate the 104th and find the Founding Titan. It killed Levi's squad in the forest of giant trees and crystallised in Stohess.

name: Beast Titan
ability: Throws hardened projectiles with impossible accuracy, controls Pure Titans through his spinal fluid, and can raise the bodies of fallen soldiers.
weakness: Slow in close quarters; its power depends on range and preparation.
history: The Beast that ended the Survey Corps' formation at Shiganshina, pitching stones like a perfect game. Its holder believed extinction was mercy.

name: Jaw Titan
ability: Crushing jaws and claws, extreme agility, and the speed to fight titans far larger than itself.
weakness: Fragile. A single mistake ends the holder, as it did for Porco.
history: Small enough to be underestimated and brutal enough to matter. Ymir's thirteen years of borrowed life began and ended with it.

name: Cart Titan
ability: Quadrupedal endurance: carries artillery, supplies and passengers across continents for days without tiring. Speaks fluently.
weakness: Minimal offensive power on its own; it is a platform, not a weapon.
history: Marley's logistics miracle. Pieck's four years of crawling through a collapsing war are the least glamorous and most decisive service in the Final Season.

name: War Hammer Titan
ability: Crystallises flesh into any weapon or structure instantly — hammers, spikes, crossbows, a wall of blades.
weakness: The holder's true body sits outside the titan inside a crystal; break it and the titan dies.
history: The Tybur family's titan, kept out of the Great Titan War as a pacifist ornament. It was eaten in Liberio within minutes of its first public fight.
